description: This file contains utility functions for downloading images, converting blobs to data URLs, creating object URLs, and handling image types and CORS configurations within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: corsify
methods.description: Adjusts URL for CORS by prepending host if necessary.

methods.name: downloadImage
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL with optional CORS handling, returns blob info and object URL.

methods.name: toDataURL
methods.description: Converts a Blob to a data URL string.

methods.name: toBlobURL
methods.description: Creates an object URL from a data URL, with caching and MIME type handling.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Converts a data URL to a Blob with specified MIME type.
